rows.notes: [T107] start_year 2020 (phase 1, 8 GWh design, 'started production and operation' June 2020) from a single broker note (S3, Huaan 2021-04-30); the 2021 AR (T093) says phase 1 capacity was 'gradually released' in 2021, and the 2020 STAR prospectus (mid-2020) still listed Zhenjiang as under construction, which is consistent with a June 2020 start. No 2020 capacity step added: first-year output was ~0.85 GWh installed company-wide (same note) and the 2021 step of 8 GWh is kept.

[T107] start_year 2023: Pedaily 2023-07-27 lists the Huzhou base among SVOLT bases 'in mass production one after another'. Not a dated first-production event (the chinadaily 2023-05-08 page cited in the v1 timeline now returns 404; Huzhou first-cell date not found), so 2023 is 'by July 2023'. Note this contradicts nothing in T008 but sits beside the SVOLT June-2023 filing that gave 2022-12-31 as 'not yet in production'. Status question (T008) is untouched; no capacity step.

[T107] start_year 2023: first batch of cells off the line (首批电芯产品下线) at Hubei Dongyu Xinsheng, reported 2023-10-12. The page is a first-cell roll-off, not a 投产 statement; later evidence of production is the 2026-05-25 120Ah cell production event (T007). The v1 timeline's '313 days' and 10 Oct 2023 date were not re-found (en.sunwoda.com page 404). No capacity step (the 20 GWh phase-1 nameplate is a design figure).

[T107] start_year 2023: phase 1 'officially ignited and put into production on 19 June this year' in an article dated 2023-07-06; consistent with the 2022 annual report (S8 not used here) that expected phase 1 in H2 2023 and the 2023 AR listing Quzhou among the bases. The year is inferred from the article date because the quote says 今年; the date does not coincide with an older article (groundbreaking was 2022-10-18). Existing {2023: 11} step kept; this source gives no GWh.
